transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, it's nice to meet you too. Thank you for seeing me. Um... well, I guess what finally pushed me to come in is... my eating has just been a little all over the place lately. I hope that's okay to bring up first? It's just that, some weeks I barely touch my dinner, which I know isn't great, and then... well, other nights I end up just standing in the kitchen eating crackers and sweets after everyone else has gone to bed. It's a little embarrassing to admit, honestly. Is that the kind of thing you need to know about?
When those late-night episodes happen, do you eat an unusually large amount of food for the situation?

Oh, um... no, I wouldn't say it's an unusually large amount. I hope I didn't make it sound like I'm completely out of control! 

Like I was saying, it's mostly just... a few extra handfuls of crackers or some sweets. I think it just happens because my appetite is so up and down, and on the days I barely touch my dinner, my body just tries to make up for it later. I really don't want you to think I'm in there emptying the whole pantry or anything. It's just the inconsistency of it all that feels so strange to me. Does that make sense? I hope I'm explaining it right.
How much does your body weight or shape affect how you feel about yourself?

Oh, um... I don't really think it affects me too much? I mean, I like to look nice, of course, just like anyone else, but I wouldn't say I obsess over my weight or my shape or anything like that. 

I try to just focus on being healthy, even if my eating is a little inconsistent right now. I really hope I don't sound vain or anything... I just try to do my best to take care of myself. Is that... is that a normal way to feel about it?
When you eat at night, has it ever happened after you were already asleep and then woke up to eat?

Oh, no, I've never done that. I always know what I'm doing when I go to the kitchen. I'm definitely awake. I would never want you to think I was sleepwalking or doing something strange like that! It's just... I'm just awake and a little hungry. That's pretty normal, right? Just a normal midnight snack kind of thing?
Do these eating patterns cause you significant distress?

Oh, no, definitely not distress. I mean, maybe it's just a tiny bit frustrating sometimes when my routine is off, but it really doesn't upset me or anything like that. I try to just take it in stride. 

I really hope I haven't been sounding like a complainer today! It's just a little quirk, I think, and I try not to let those little things get to me. I just want to make sure I'm doing the right things overall. Is it... is it okay that it doesn't really bother me? I hope that's a good sign.
